provenance: Self-authored original15751 firmware programs. Complete320x240 RGB frames at actual WAIT(0), exact returned text ends and Home settings. No raw vendor captures/fonts bundled.

cases.name: unitref
cases.source: EXPORT UNITREF() BEGIN RECT_P(#112233h); LOCAL x,r:={}; IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("AB",10,10,3,#FFFFFFh); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("A"+CHAR(55296)+"B",10,30,3,#FFFFFFh); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("A"+CHAR(56320)+"B",10,50,3,#FFFFFFh); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("A"+CHAR(55357)+CHAR(56832)+"B",10,70,3,#FFFFFFh); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("A"+CHAR(128512)+"B",10,90,3,#FFFFFFh); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("A"+CHAR(0)+"B",10,110,3,#FFFFFFh); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("A"+CHAR(9)+"B",10,130,3,#FFFFFFh); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("A"+CHAR(13)+"B",10,150,3,#FFFFFFh); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("A"+CHAR(10)+"B",10,170,3,#FFFFFFh); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("A"+CHAR(65279)+"B",10,190,3,#FFFFFFh); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); WAIT(0); RETURN r; END;

cases.name: textval
cases.source: EXPORT TEXTVAL() BEGIN RECT_P(#112233h); LOCAL x,r:={}; IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P(12345,10,10,3,#FFFFFFh); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P({"A","B"},10,35,3,#FFFFFFh); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P([[1,2],[3,4]],10,60,3,#FFFFFFh); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P((-1,2),10,85,3,#FFFFFFh); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P(1E20,10,110,3,#FFFFFFh); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("A,B",10,135,3,#FFFFFFh); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P(CHAR(55296),10,160,3,#FFFFFFh); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P(CHAR(55357)+CHAR(56832),10,185,3,#FFFFFFh); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); WAIT(0); RETURN {r,HSeparator,HFormat,HDigits}; END;

cases.name: menu_units
cases.source: EXPORT MENUREF() BEGIN RECT_P(#112233h); LOCAL r:=DRAWMENU({"A"+CHAR(55296)+"B","A"+CHAR(56320)+"B","A"+CHAR(55357)+CHAR(56832)+"B",CHAR(55296),CHAR(65279),CHAR(0)}); WAIT(0); RETURN {r,TYPE(r)}; END;

cases.name: widths
cases.source: EXPORT TEXTMORE() BEGIN RECT_P(#112233h); LOCAL k,w:={-1,0,1,5,8,9,10,13,14,15,17,18,19,22,23,24,25,26,30},x,r:={}; FOR k FROM 1 TO 19 DO IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("A"+CHAR(55296)+"B",10,5+12*(k-1),3,#FFFFFFh,w(k),#224466h); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); END; WAIT(0); RETURN r; END;

cases.name: clear
cases.source: EXPORT TEXTCLEAR() BEGIN RECT_P(#112233h); LOCAL x,r:={}; IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("AB",10,5,3,#FFFFFFh,0,#224466h); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("AB",10,24,3,#FFFFFFh,32,#224466h); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("AB",10,43,3,#FFFFFFh,50,#224466h); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("AB",10,62,3,#FFFFFFh,100,#224466h); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("",10,81,3,#FFFFFFh,50,#224466h); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("",10,100,3,#FFFFFFh,0,#224466h); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P(CHAR(0),10,119,3,#FFFFFFh,50,#224466h); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("AB",10,138,3,#FFFFFFh,0.5,#224466h); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("AB",10,157,3,#FFFFFFh,1.5,#224466h); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("AB",10,176,3,#FFFFFFh,2.5,#224466h); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("AB",10,195,3,#FFFFFFh,-0.5,#224466h); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); IFERR x:=TEXTOUT_P("AB",10,214,3,#FFFFFFh,-1.5,#224466h); THEN x:="error"; END; r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); WAIT(0); RETURN r; END;

cases.name: background
cases.source: EXPORT TEXTBACK() BEGIN RECT_P(#112233h); LOCAL f,x,r:={}; FOR f FROM 1 TO 7 DO x:=TEXTOUT_P("A",10,5+30*(f-1),f,#FFFFFFh,100,#224466h); r:=CONCAT(r,{x}); END; WAIT(0); RETURN r; END;
